trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** in all production regions — the rollback completed successfully, and the service is now healthy with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), describing the health-check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the need to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures before attempting another release. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the first attempt to create the incident timed out, so I verified no incident had been created (none existed) before retrying — the retry succeeded, so on-call was only paged once.
